notes.title: The game is now released and available!
notes.notes:
🎉🎉 PERV'S HOTEL, LUST FROM SWEDEN 🎉🎉


Hey everyone! 🚀 We're thrilled to finally announce the launch of Perv's Hotel, Lust from Sweden!
Dive into a steamy, drama-filled journey with our latest visual novel that will challenge your choices and tug at your emotions. 💖

🛎️ THE STORY 🛎️
In Perv's Hotel, you play as Tom, a man on the edge. His once-thriving hotel, managed with his stunning girlfriend Samuela, is now on the brink of bankruptcy. 💔 To make things worse, Samuela, feeling the pressure from her family, decides to take a break from their relationship, leaving Tom in a whirlwind of emotions.

But all hope is not lost! 🌟 Tom's loyal best friend Lucine sticks by his side just when things seem to fall apart. And then, the story takes a wild twist: a mysterious stranger shows up with an offer that’s impossible to resist... 

And that's just the beginning! Soon, the hotel becomes the temporary home for gorgeous Olympic athletes from Sweden, led by the tough but alluring manager Miss Inga. 🏋️‍♀️

We won’t spoil all the surprises, but let's just say, your choices will change everything! 😉

🔀 CHOICE-BASED GAMEPLAY 🔀
Your decisions in Perv's Hotel matter. With a rich system of choices influencing character traits, plot directions, and unlocking a gallery of replays, no two playthroughs will be the same! Get ready to explore numerous alternate endings (in the complete version) and shape Tom's destiny!

🚀 WHAT'S INCLUDED IN THE EARLY ACCESS RELEASE 🚀
✨ **Images** 2000+  
🎬 **Animations** 40+  
📝 **Words** 25,000+  
❓ **Choices** 85+  
🏆 **Achievements** 270+  



Don't miss out on the chance to dive into Tom's world, where every choice matters and every encounter can change everything. 



See you at the hotel... 🛎️🔥
